ceilings.hint: Ultra-matt finish minimises roller marks and light reflection.

bathrooms.hint: Moisture and mould resistance for humid environments. Use with Luja Universal Primer.

kitchens.hint: Exceptional washability and stain resistance for high-use areas.

hallways.hint: Durable and washable for high-traffic areas.

children's-rooms.hint: Easy to clean and highly durable. Consider Harmony for air-purifying properties.

bedrooms.hint: Premium washable matt with excellent coverage.

living-rooms.hint: High-quality matt finish with excellent washability.

exterior-wood.hint: Premium weather protection with UV resistance.

exterior-masonry.hint: Durable, breathable masonry paint with anti-fungal properties.

decking.hint: Penetrating oil with water-repellent and UV protection.

interior-trim.hint: Water-based enamel with excellent flow. Use Everal Aqua for high gloss.

floors-concrete.hint: Heavy-duty floor paint for garages, basements, workshops.

floors-wood.hint: Durable lacquer for interior wood floors. Use Supi Lattiaöljy for oil finish.

furniture.hint: Chalk paint for vintage look, or Helmi/Everal Aqua for durable finish.

tieBreakers: Prefer washable/scrub-class paints (Optiva Satin) over Vinyl Matt when durability is requested.
Prefer water-based enamels (Helmi/Everal Aqua) for interior trim unless solvent-based specifically required.
For moisture issues, always recommend Luja system with primer.
For high-traffic areas, recommend Optiva Satin [5] over Optiva Matt [3].
For eco-conscious customers, recommend Harmony Interior.
For budget-conscious projects, suggest Vinyl Matt W448 for low-traffic areas.
Always mention primer for bare surfaces, difficult substrates, or moisture-prone areas.

surfacePrep.new-plaster: Allow to dry completely (4-6 weeks). Apply mist coat (paint diluted 10-20% with water) or use appropriate primer.
surfacePrep.previously-painted: Clean, sand lightly if glossy, fill any holes/cracks, wipe clean.
surfacePrep.bare-wood: Sand smooth, remove dust, apply wood primer (Otex Akva) or undercoat.
surfacePrep.metal: Remove rust, degrease, apply anti-corrosive primer (Rostex Super).
surfacePrep.tiles: Clean and degrease thoroughly. Use adhesion primer (Otex Akva).
